name: Everything Is a Tribe
effect: Boosting this layer-4 neuron makes the model read whatever words are in the prompt as the name of a Native American people and answer with a tribal encyclopedia entry, a list of tribes, or a claim of tribal identity.
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 38/40 held-out pairs. Near miss: judged alone, it failed only the strict specificity check.
